amendments.name: Small-community grants
amendments.detail: Regional coalition +40 support; reform caucus +5. Adds 3 spending per quarter and extends benefits to every region.

amendments.name: Independent oversight
amendments.detail: Pragmatic center +25; budget hawks +10. Adds 1 spending per quarter; protects construction from procurement failures.

amendments.name: Progressive revenue package
amendments.detail: Budget hawks +35; center +5; regional coalition −10. Raises the progressive tax setting one step when the bill passes.

warning.title: Storm watch: the coast
warning.body: Forecasters warn of a severe storm next quarter. Grid strength and preparation will determine the damage.

choices.title: Monitor and conserve funds
choices.detail: No new cost · infrastructure must withstand the storm

landfall.title: Landfall and power failures
landfall.body: Damage level {damage}. Governors need a response before the next quarter.

choices.title: Order rapid federal relief
choices.detail: Debt +8 · recover up to 7 local points · hurried contracts may trigger scrutiny

choices.title: Coordinate audited state assistance
choices.detail: Debt +4 · recover up to 4 local points · lower procurement risk

investigation.title: The procurement investigation
investigation.body: Auditors found irregularities in emergency or construction contracts. Your response will shape trust in the program.

stages.speaker: Senator Adrian Vale
stages.question: “Your record on {issue} is your weak point. Why should voters give you another term?”

choices.title: Defend your measurable record
choices.detail: Trust +2 if the issue score is at least 52; otherwise −2

stages.speaker: Moderator: Jordan Ellis
stages.question: “You have heard the challenge. What will you put on the record tonight?”

choices.title: Commit to the published platform
choices.detail: Momentum −4 if at least two goals are on track; otherwise trust −1

stages.speaker: Correspondent Jordan Ellis
stages.question: “You promised results. What evidence can the public see today?”

choices.title: Publish the implementation timeline
choices.detail: Trust +1 · a follow-up question on accountability

choices.title: Declare the program a success
choices.detail: Trust +2 with a completed project; otherwise −3

stages.speaker: Correspondent Jordan Ellis
stages.question: “Are you claiming success before the results have arrived?”

questionAfter.timeline: “Will you also publish missed deadlines and cost overruns?”
